<thought>The 13C NMR shows a single carbon signal in the typical methyl region (≈ 19 ppm). This indicates that the molecule contains methyl carbon(s). Since only one distinct methyl carbon environment is observed, all methyl groups present must be chemically equivalent. The simplest interpretation is that there is a single methyl group in the structure. Therefore, the number of methyl (CH₃) groups is 1.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
